card.name: Comma ending an if-clause before instruction
card.fires_on: The comma (or closing punctuation) that ends a conditional "If ... is necessary/required" clause in pregnancy or use warnings, right before the instruction begins.

modes.label: If-clause comma
modes.description: Comma after a conditional clause about needing a drug, just before a directive like limit or advise.
modes.example: If NSAID treatment is necessary between about 20 weeks and 30 weeks gestation<<,>> limit naproxen tablets or naprox

modes.label: List bullet or bracket
modes.description: Bullet or closing parenthesis after a section reference in a contraindication list or conditional cross-reference.

card.plain: It marks the comma at the end of an "if treatment is needed" clause, just before the instruction that follows.
